places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: Clara and Augustus talk by her unconscious husband; she invites Lorena to stay, Lorena accepts, and Augustus rides off that night.
places.location_hint: horse ranch on the Platte in Nebraska, near Ogallala

places.name: North Platte River
places.note: Clara urges Augustus to settle along it on cheap land; he rides off toward it.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Cholo rides there with Augustus to fetch the clothes bought for Lorena.

places.raw_name: the salt fork of the Brazos
places.name: Brazos River
places.note: Ranger Tom Mustard's horse fell over a cutbank on its salt fork, breaking his back.
places.location_hint: Salt Fork of the Brazos, northwest Texas

places.name: Austin
places.note: The Rangers carried the paralyzed Tom Mustard toward it; Clara left romance behind when she left it.

places.name: Mobile
places.note: Lorena's happiest memory is a night in her grandmother's house there at age four.

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Even in Lorena's dreams of it, nobody had asked her to stay.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: During her years there Lorena seldom spoke with another woman.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Montana
places.note: Clara calls it no place for a lady; Augustus wants to see one last unsettled country.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Clara asks if he calls it settled; he predicts schoolhouses soon.

groups.label: Clara's household
groups.hint: Lorena now staying with Clara while the herd goes on

groups.label: Augustus and Cholo
groups.hint: riding at night from Clara's toward the Platte and Ogallala

groups.label: Call and Newt with horses
groups.at: Hat Creek herd camp near Ogallala
groups.hint: left Clara's earlier with the bought horses, heading back to the herd
